drafted_from: tool:mix-sound-layers's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/layer-over-video.mjs, tools/media-composition/test/layer-over-video.test.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip with a 10 second tone as the music
start_here: Say to your AI: "Put my music file under my video at 30% volume with a one second fade in and out, ducking under speech, and even the loudness out to -14." It runs tool:mix-sound-layers and saves the new video in your files.
no_lists_because: It makes a new video in your files from the video you name and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find the identities in your files of the video and of each sound (music, voice-over or effect).

2. Say "Lay this music under the video" with video and sounds: each is {file, start (seconds into the video), optional from and to (trim of the sound file), volume (1 as recorded, 0.3 suits music under speech), fade_in, fade_out, duck, label}. Add loudness_lufs (-14 suits most sites) to even out the whole video.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:mix-sound-layers. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Read result (duration_seconds, bytes, sounds: how many were laid) and files.video, the new video in your files. Check it with tool:measure-loudness.

worked_examples.title: Music at 30%, faded, ducked, and levelled to -14
worked_examples.ask: Put my music under the video quietly and level it to -14.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/media-composition/do-work/layer-over-video.mjs (the translation is tested in tools/media-composition/test/layer-over-video.test.mjs) and run on a 7 second clip with a 10 second tone as the music: the music stops when the video ends
